"I want to work at a company strong in SNS marketing," "I want to see business results, not just ad operations," "I want to grow with autonomy from a young age"—AXIS Inc. is a company that those people should pay attention to.

AXIS is an advertising agency that supports the entire customer acquisition funnel from awareness to conversion, centered on SNS marketing. They are particularly strong in performance-based SNS advertising, and their scope of support extends beyond ad operations to include creative improvement, CRM, and ROAS improvement.

In this article, based on their official website and the Best Venture 100 listing page, we will organize their business content, strengths, growth potential, culture, and the type of people who are a good fit.
1. What is AXIS Inc.?

AXIS Inc. is an SNS marketing company established on June 1, 2020. The co-representatives are Masaya Iga and Kanta Koyasu. The capital is 10 million yen, and the number of employees is 114 (group-wide).
